2609.18533.title: A Probe Shift Is Not a Fairness Fix: The Limits of Representation Steering in Speech Models
2609.18533.paper_summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems exhibit unequal error rates across speaker groups, motivating interventions on their internal representations. We ask whether speaker-linked attributes that are linearly readable from pretrained ASR encoders yield useful directions for reducing group word-error-rate (WER) gaps. Across Whisper-medium, HuBERT-large, and Wav2Vec2-large on Common Voice and the Speech Accent Archive, we probe every encoder layer for metadata-derived sex/gender, age, and native/accent labels; construct centroid and probe-derived directions; inject them at selected layers; and compare downstream probe trajectories with matched WER changes. Sex labels are highly decodable (best macro-F1 0.924--0.941), native/accent labels are also above chance (0.544--0.696), and age is weaker (0.354--0.397). Of 22 post-selected reruns, nine have 95% paired-bootstrap intervals entirely below zero, yet every absolute source-group WER reduction is below 0.7 percentage points. Conversely, a local target-class probe rate can rise from 8.09% to 99.87% while WER worsens. Linear readability is therefore neither evidence of causal use nor a reliable mitigation method. Our results motivate evaluating speech-bias interventions jointly at representation, propagation, and task levels.
2609.18533.paper_summary_zh: 自動語音識別（ASR）系統在不同說話者群體之間顯示出不平等的錯誤率，這促使我們對其內部表示進行干預。我們詢問從預訓練的ASR編碼器中線性可讀的與說話者相關的屬性是否能提供有用的方向，以減少群體詞錯誤率（WER）差距。在Common Voice和Speech Accent Archive上，我們對Whisper-medium、HuBERT-large和Wav2Vec2-large的每個編碼器層進行探查，涉及元數據衍生的性別/性別、年齡和母語/口音標籤；構建質心和探測衍生的方向；在選定的層中注入它們；並比較下游探測軌跡與匹配的WER變化。性別標籤的可解碼性很高（最佳宏F1 0.924--0.941），母語/口音標籤也高於隨機機率（0.544--0.696），而年齡的可解碼性較弱（0.354--0.397）。在22次後選擇的重跑中，有九次的95%配對自助法區間完全低於零，但每個絕對源群體的WER減少都低於0.7個百分點。相反，局部目標類別的探測率可以從8.09%上升到99.87%，而WER卻惡化。因此，線性可讀性既不是因果使用的證據，也不是可靠的緩解方法。我們的結果促使我們在表示、傳播和任務層面上共同評估語音偏見干預。
